subject: planner: refactor order ratio code (#61787)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs first parent (46e26712bf...) focusing on `pkg/planner/cardinality/cross_estimation.go` and its caller path in `pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go`. The change refactors LIMIT rowcount/cost adjustment for index scans by applying the correlation-based estimate first, then a bounded order-ratio interpolation (`tidb_opt_ordering_index_selectivity_ratio` in [-1,1]); this affects plan costing/estRows but not SQL semantics, privilege/visibility, transaction/session correctness, or executor runtime behavior. The only executor-side change is test SQL using explicit `@@session.` when setting `tidb_opt_enable_late_materialization`.
